structured_output.what_is_happening: "Felis Margarita" (Felis) is riding a viral story about a sand cat kitten whose real photos look AI-generated. It was not a pump.fun bonding-curve launch. It was created at about 13:04 UTC and a PumpSwap pool was opened directly about 50 seconds later (migrated_unix=0, no 'pump' address suffix, launchpad empty). The pool holds about 75% of supply and about $249k of liquidity, which is more than the $168k market cap. The LP is 0% locked/burned and has few providers, so the deployer or a small group supplied it and can remove it at any time. In 35 minutes it traded $4.8M (19x hourly turnover) and the price rose about 96%. Buys came from about 2,088 unique wallets, but about 3,100 sells came from only 48-54 unique sellers. GMGN flags 49 bundler wallets holding about 20% of top-trader share. At least 10 same-name or SANDCAT copies exist, several already drained to near-zero liquidity.

narrative.description: A cute-animal meme tied to an organic-sounding viral X moment (a sand cat kitten that 'looks AI but is real'). It has broad appeal and an easy image, the kind of subject that often produces one winning ticker for the day.
narrative.why_spreading: A viral animal clip on X, a crowded same-name launch race, and a surge of retail buyers (2k unique buyers in about 35 minutes) show real attention to the theme. The thread is linked through an X community, not a dedicated project account.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is currently the largest-liquidity and highest-volume 'Felis' ticker, and the only one with deep liquidity. That likely draws flow from traders sorting by liquidity or volume.
token_connection.competing_tokens: At least 7 other 'Felis/Felis Margarita' tokens and 3 'SANDCAT/Felis margarita' tokens. SANDCAT HgGb... is at a $373k market cap with $483k volume in the last hour, and SANDCAT E1eb... has $573k hourly volume. The pump.fun Felis J4yq... launched about 12 minutes earlier. Several Felis copies already show near-zero liquidity (rugged).

authenticity.evidence: Buyer and seller wallets are extremely lopsided: 2,088 unique buyers against 54 unique sellers who made about 3,100 sells. That points to a small set of wallets (dev, bundlers or market-making bots) steadily selling into retail buying. GMGN flags 49 bundler wallets. The pool was self-seeded right at creation with deep, unlocked LP, a known pattern for looking 'safe' before pulling the LP. There is no website or socials beyond a link to an X search, and no DexScreener profile.
authenticity.uncertainty: The retail buying is probably genuine interest in the theme. The 54 sellers could partly be arbitrage or MEV bots rather than the dev. A high count of unique buyers does count against pure wash trading.

structural_risks: 0% of the LP is locked/burned and there are few LP providers. About $124k of SOL can be withdrawn instantly.
Liquidity exceeds market cap, a signature of a self-seeded direct PumpSwap pool rather than an organic curve graduation.
54 unique sellers made about 3,100 sells, suggesting steady extraction.
49 bundler wallets hold about 20% of top-trader share.
A crowded ticker war, with some competitors holding comparable or larger market caps.
The price already doubled within the hour, so the entry comes after the first leg.

structured_output.counterargument: Deep liquidity and 2k+ unique buyers within 35 minutes on a genuinely viral animal story could make this the default 'Felis' ticker. Deep LP also absorbs sells, and a $168k→$340k move is small next to $4.8M of hourly volume. If the deployer is playing the long game and earning LP fees instead of rugging, a KOL or the viral wave could push it past $400k within hours.
unknowns: Who supplied the LP, and whether it is the creator wallet
Whether the X virality is still growing or has peaked
Whether a competitor ticker becomes the consensus coin
Price action in the 25 minutes before entry

structured_output.thesis: The narrative is real but crowded. This token's structure strongly suggests a self-seeded, unlocked-LP pool with a small group of sellers extracting from retail flow. It is more likely to have its LP pulled or bleed out than to double again from an entry that comes after a +96% move.
